# LanDeng — Fragrance Data

> Structured reference data for plant-based fragrance and aromatherapy work: aroma profiles, ingredient records, botanical entities and comparison datasets.

## Data
- [Index](index.md): How the dataset is organised.
- [Datasets](datasets.md): Available datasets and their fields.
- [Aromas](aroma.md): Aroma profile records.
- [Ingredients](ingredients.md): Ingredient-level entries.
- [Comparisons](comparisons.md): Side-by-side comparisons.
- [Entities](entities/): Botanical and material entity records.
- [Format](format.md): Data format and field definitions.

## Notes
- Records are reference data compiled for educational use, not therapeutic claims.
